name: ShengJinRunZaoYangXue granules
short: In a 6-week trial in 240 people with Sjögren's syndrome, 2 serious adverse events, both autoimmune liver disease, occurred on the granules; adverse events were 15.6% vs 10.0% with placebo.
text: The only safety evidence found is a 6-week multicentre, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 240 people with primary Sjögren's syndrome in East China (160 assigned to the granules and 80 to placebo). Adverse events occurred in 15.6% of the granule group and 10.0% of the placebo group; most (94%) were mild to moderate, and the only two serious adverse events occurred in the granule group and were both caused by autoimmune liver disease. The abstract does not say whether the liver disease was judged to be caused by the granules, and it does not list the herbs in the formula. No interaction data were found in the cited source.
